name: DoortectiveAI
tagline: A smart doorbell that sees, recognises and talks with visitors in any language, verifying guests by code.
problem: Doorbells only ring; they do not handle visitors.
solution: A Raspberry Pi camera detects and recognises visitors, converses through voice AI, verifies guests with codes and handles deliveries.
demo_moment: Team-described: a delivery driver is greeted and guided.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “People's Choice Hack - Bitcamp” and “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 223 submissions.
Won the hackers' vote and a voice AI prize.

lessons: Personality in a device wins the crowd vote.
